scope: Frozen failed-model sensitivity diagnosis on135 natural validation words only; no external evaluation, retraining, calibration or promotion

preprocessing.baseline: RGB float32 /255, unchanged internal model Rescaling(2,-1)
preprocessing.formula: per-channel z=(RGB-mean)/max(sample_std,1e-6); mean z across3 channels; clip(.5+target_std*zgray,0,1); repeat3 RGB channels
preprocessing.channel_statistics: float64 accumulation, cast mean/std tofloat32, sample std ddof1; transform remainsfloat32
preprocessing.clipping: After grayscale; values outside[0,1] clipped; no uint8 requantization
preprocessing.source_distinction: AngelinaReader subtracts channel means, divides by3*std with a configurable std floor, then averages channels. These bounded[0,1] probes are adaptations for this different frozen model, not reproduction of that model's input contract.

quality_assumptions.reported_modes: decoder_only; unchanged quality thresholds applied after each transform; unchanged precheck applied to original RGB before every transform. All rejections count as word failures.

limitations: Normalization changes the input distribution of a model trained onrawRGB; this does not predict success after retraining.
Validation-only results cannot establish external or physical-camera accuracy.
No thresholds, clipping parameters, preprocessing choice, or model was promoted from this diagnostic.
